user.title: Choose the connection
user.description: An HCH5 MK1 with HAC1 is read passively through a transparent RS485-over-TCP adapter or a USB-RS485 adapter connected directly to the Home Assistant host; both modes are read-only. A Dantherm unit with the Dantherm Residential Modbus map (HCH5 MKII, RCV, HCV, HCC) is read and controlled over Modbus TCP.

tcp.title: Connect using RS485 over TCP
tcp.description: Enter the address of the adapter's raw TCP stream. The integration never sends requests or commands.

mk2.title: Dantherm unit over Modbus TCP
mk2.description: Connect directly to a Dantherm unit with the Dantherm Residential Modbus map – HCH5 MKII, RCV, HCV or HCC – over Modbus TCP. You get readings and control of operation mode, fan step, bypass, filter and alarms – no Raspberry Pi needed.

serial.title: Connect using USB-RS485
serial.description: Enter the stable device path, preferably /dev/serial/by-id/.... The port is opened read-only at 19200 8E1 and the integration never calls write().

error.cannot_connect: Connected, but no valid Dantherm RTU traffic was received.

heating_coil_air_delta.name: Air delta T across heating coil

init.title: Dantherm Control settings
init.description: Change the connection, controller and integration settings. The classic listening data path remains read-only.

data.filter_notify_days: Warn this many days before replacement
data.controller_api_enabled: Connect to the Raspberry Pi controller API

controller.title: Raspberry Pi controller and Smart Auto
controller.description: Enter the IP address and port the Raspberry Pi controller runs on. Home Assistant only sends commands and the sensors you choose; the Pi makes all ventilation decisions.

data.controller_host: Controller IP address or host name
data.smart_rooms_enabled: Use Home Assistant sensors in Smart Auto

controller_sensors.title: Sensors sent to the controller
controller_sensors.description: Choose sensors and an optional weather entity for the controller at {controller}. T1 always comes from the unit. Weather conditions appear in the WebUI; humidity affects control only if enabled on the Pi and the data pass the T1 check. Clear a field to stop sending it.

data.unit_power_entity: Power meter on the unit (optional, shown in the Pi WebUI)
data.unit_energy_today_entity: Unit energy today in kWh (optional, e.g. a daily utility meter)
data.electricity_price_entity: Electricity price in DKK/kWh (optional, øre/kWh is converted)
data.heat_price_entity: Heat price in DKK/kWh (optional, øre/kWh is converted)
data.weather_entity: Weather source for the WebUI and optional humidity control

controller_menu.title: Controller setup
controller_menu.description: Values are read directly from the Pi controller. Changes are stored on the Pi, which remains the source of truth.

controller_settings.title: Controller parameters
controller_settings.description: These values are stored directly on the Raspberry Pi controller.

fan_steps.title: Dantherm 4 steps
fan_steps.description: Commission as on Dantherm's HCP4 panel: step 3 is the nominal airflow (gear 46-91 per fan). Steps 2 and 1 lie one and two offsets below, and step 4 is the maximum. Supply follows the air balance when it is on Auto.

fan_profiles.title: Ventilation profiles 1-6 (six-step control)
fan_profiles.description: Extract must be higher than supply, and both values must increase from level 1 through 6.

rooms_menu.title: Smart Auto sensors and rooms
rooms_menu.description: Add any rooms and sensors you want. A room can control ventilation or be monitor-only. Priority changes how early/strongly a room affects ventilation; seriously poor readings are never ignored.

add_room.title: Add Smart Auto room
add_room.description: Select at least one temperature, humidity, CO₂ or PM2.5 sensor. Only supported sensors are listed: temperature in °C, humidity in %, CO₂ and PM2.5 in µg/m³. PM2.5 is only used when it is enabled on the Pi.

room_detail.title: Edit Smart Auto room
room_detail.description: Temporarily disable a room, make it monitor-only, or change priority without changing controller code. Only supported sensors are listed: temperature in °C, humidity in %, CO₂ and PM2.5 in µg/m³. PM2.5 is only used when it is enabled on the Pi.

remove_room.title: Remove Smart Auto room
remove_room.description: Only removes the room from Dantherm Smart Auto. The selected Home Assistant sensor is not deleted.

tcp.title: RS485 over TCP
tcp.description: Enter the IP address and TCP port of the Raspberry Pi gateway or RS485-to-Ethernet adapter.

mk2.title: Dantherm unit over Modbus TCP
mk2.description: Connect directly to a Dantherm unit with the Dantherm Residential Modbus map – HCH5 MKII, RCV, HCV or HCC – over Modbus TCP. You get readings and control of operation mode, fan step, bypass, filter and alarms – no Raspberry Pi needed.

serial.title: Local USB-RS485 adapter
serial.description: Enter the stable device path of the USB adapter, preferably /dev/serial/by-id/....

error.cannot_connect: The connection could not be validated, or no valid Dantherm traffic was received.
error.controller_cannot_connect: The controller API could not be reached or the token could not be authenticated.
error.controller_update_failed: The controller rejected the change or the connection was interrupted.
error.required: This field is required for the selected connection type.
error.room_name_duplicate: A Smart Auto room with this name already exists.
error.room_requires_sensor: Select at least one sensor for the room.

connection_lost.title: No connection to the gateway or unit
connection_lost.description: Dantherm Control has been unable to connect to the configured RS485 gateway or Modbus TCP unit for more than 15 minutes. Check its power and network connection, and that the transparent TCP stream or Modbus TCP is still active. Open the integration's options if the address has changed.

hac1_disconnected.title: HAC1 indoor-climate module not responding
hac1_disconnected.description: RS485 traffic from the Dantherm unit is still present, but the HAC1 module (CO2/indoor climate) has not reported itself as connected for more than 15 minutes. Check the HAC1 module's wiring and power.
